title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program \ Anthropic
summary: Anthropic announced three CVP access levels on October 6, 2026: Defense, Red Team, and Specialized.
Defense eligibility examples include individual researchers who have reported vulnerabilities; this project does not establish such a track record.
Applicants are verified and must substantiate the security controls for the relevant tier.
